# newreleases_project (Resource)

Tracks a project on newreleases.io and configures where its release notifications are delivered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Minimal: track releases without notifications.
resource "newreleases_project" "terraform" {
  provider_name = "github"
  name          = "hashicorp/terraform"
}

# Full: daily email digest, a Slack channel, a tag and version filters.
data "newreleases_slack_channels" "all" {}

resource "newreleases_tag" "golang" {
  name = "golang"
}

resource "newreleases_project" "go" {
  provider_name       = "github"
  name                = "golang/go"
  email_notification  = "daily"
  slack_channels      = [for c in data.newreleases_slack_channels.all.channels : c.id if c.channel == "releases"]
  tags                = [newreleases_tag.golang.id]
  exclude_prereleases = true
  note                = "Managed by Terraform"

  exclude_version_regexp = [
    {
      value = "^weekly\\."
    },
    {
      # Only track stable go1.x releases.
      value   = "^go1\\.\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$"
      inverse = true
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name at the upstream provider, for example `golang/go`. Changing this forces a new project.
- `provider_name` (String) Upstream provider hosting the project, for example `github`, `gitlab`, `pypi`, `npm` or `dockerhub`. See the `newreleases_providers` data source for the full list. Changing this forces a new project.

### Optional

- `discord_channels` (Set of String) IDs of Discord channels to notify. See the `newreleases_discord_channels` data source.
- `email_notification` (String) Email notification schedule: `none`, `instant`, `hourly`, `daily`, `weekly` or `default` (inherit the account setting). Defaults to `none`.
- `exclude_prereleases` (Boolean) Do not notify about pre-release versions.
- `exclude_updated` (Boolean) Do not notify about updates of already published releases.
- `exclude_version_regexp` (Attributes Set) Regular expressions filtering which versions are tracked. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--exclude_version_regexp))
- `hangouts_chat_webhooks` (Set of String) IDs of Google Hangouts Chat webhooks to notify. See the `newreleases_hangouts_chat_webhooks` data source.
- `matrix_rooms` (Set of String) IDs of Matrix rooms to notify. See the `newreleases_matrix_rooms` data source.
- `mattermost_webhooks` (Set of String) IDs of Mattermost webhooks to notify. See the `newreleases_mattermost_webhooks` data source.
- `microsoft_teams_webhooks` (Set of String) IDs of Microsoft Teams webhooks to notify. See the `newreleases_microsoft_teams_webhooks` data source.
- `note` (String) Free-form note attached to the project.
- `rocketchat_webhooks` (Set of String) IDs of Rocket.Chat webhooks to notify. See the `newreleases_rocketchat_webhooks` data source.
- `slack_channels` (Set of String) IDs of Slack channels to notify. See the `newreleases_slack_channels` data source.
- `tags` (Set of String) IDs of tags assigned to the project. See the `newreleases_tag` resource.
- `telegram_chats` (Set of String) IDs of Telegram chats to notify. See the `newreleases_telegram_chats` data source.
- `webhooks` (Set of String) IDs of generic webhooks to notify. See the `newreleases_webhooks` data source.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Project ID assigned by newreleases.io.
- `url` (String) URL of the project at the upstream provider.

<a id="nestedatt--exclude_version_regexp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `exclude_version_regexp`

Required:

- `value` (String) Regular expression matched against the version.

Optional:

- `inverse` (Boolean) When true, the regular expression is an inclusion filter: only matching versions are tracked.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By project ID
terraform import newreleases_project.go pf4w494lbjsd3ydp5hnf4gsptw
# By provider and name
terraform import newreleases_project.go github/golang/go
```
